# Xplania

> Web app for students going abroad for an Erasmus, an exchange or an internship. It helps them prepare their departure: first-month budget, visa and paperwork, housing, packing list and cultural codes, in one place. French and English. Free during the beta.

Xplania starts with a 2-minute questionnaire (no account needed) that shows the student's 3 priorities right away. The answers then feed five connected preparation tools — Budget, Visa & paperwork, Packing list, Culture guide and Housing assistant — and a dashboard that shows the next step and what is left to prepare. Public country guides cover 29 destinations with official links (France Diplomatie, Institut Pasteur, official entry sites).

Xplania does not sell flights, hotels or tours, and does not publish housing listings.

## Pages

- [Home](/): What Xplania does, the questions students ask before leaving, an example of the 3 priorities, FAQ.
- [Questionnaire](/preparation): 7 questions about the stay (destination, origin, type of stay, dates, budget, housing); open to visitors.
- [Country guides](/preparer): Visa, health, budget, housing and cultural codes for 29 destinations, with islands and overseas territories (Canary Islands, Réunion…).
- [Budget guide](/guide-budget): First-month budget, monthly costs and income, margin, saving tips. Usable without an account.
- [Visa & paperwork guide](/guide-visa): Formalities for the student's nationality, summarized from official sources with the consultation date, and a checklist. Usable without an account.
- [Culture guide](/guide-culture): Cultural codes of the destination (greetings, social life, studies and work), hand-written for most guide countries. Usable without an account.
- [Packing list](/guide-valise): List based on the usual weather of the months on site, the type of stay and the luggage. Account required (choices are saved).
- [Housing assistant](/guide-logement): Hand-checked places to search, comparator, anti-scam checks, link with the Budget. Account required.
- [Offers](/offres): Free beta (10 AI tries per tool each month); student packs and school pricing (student price × number of students), payments not active yet.
- [About](/a-propos): Why Xplania exists and who builds it (Juliette Noël, founder).
- [Trust & security](/securite): How Xplania protects user data.
